The Mil Mi-8 Hip is a twin-engine medium transport helicopter, the most-produced helicopter in history with about 17,000 built since 1967. The Soviet and Russian workhorse flies troops, cargo, and medevac missions in over 50 countries; the armed Mi-8AMTSh serves as a gunship transport.
